items.name: Potato Please

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: over the hill
items.sub: Funselektor Labs Inc. · Adventure, Casual, Racing
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
items.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
items.desc: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

items.name: Space Engineers 2
items.sub: Keen Software House · Simulation, Sandbox, Action
items.desc: Space Engineers 2 is a playable Early Access Alpha sandbox focused on engineering, exploration, and colonization in a fully destructible universe. Design and build ships, stations, and planetary bases while uncovering the story of Miro and Ivan Sokol. Help shape the future of the Almagest system.

items.name: MIMESIS
items.sub: ReLU Games, Inc. · Action, Adventure, Casual
items.desc: A 4-player online co-op survival horror game. Avoid the contaminated rain, gather scrap and get back to the tram. Monsters that copy your friends' voices and behavior, and many other threats, stand in your way. Gear up and stick together to survive.

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: Potato Please
items.desc: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

items.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
items.desc: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, earn as much money as you can, and get ready for the next mission.

items.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost
items.desc: "The collapse of Gensokyo... it was all you - " To rebuild the now barren phantasia, Reimu's journey begins. A Touhou Project officially approved derivative rhythm action game.

items.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
items.desc: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

items.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
items.desc: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

items.name: DOPA-MATCH3: Cosmic Journey
items.desc: The best-feeling match-3 game in the universe. Line up three gems and let them vanish with a twinkle. Fill the HEAT gauge and the ultimate combo time begins. Clear the LEVEL, pick an upgrade card, and grow permanently stronger for the long journey ahead.

items.name: Prerolled
items.desc: Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder! Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box! Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

items.name: The Cinder Throne
items.desc: The Cinder Throne is an Idler RPG where you passively kill enemies, level up, loot enemies, change pieces of equipment and find spells. Create powerfull synergies. Rebirth and come back stronger than ever

items.name: The 9th Haunted Corridor
items.desc: The 9th Haunted Corridor is a short horror game where you must spot anomalies in an endless corridor and survive the paranormal phenomena that await you. Observe your surroundings carefully, do not overlook any strange details, and escape from the infinite haunted corridor.
